brief:
Former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett called for a "campaign" against Qatar, Shehab Wire reported. Bennett accused Doha of inflicting "massive destruction" on Israel and proposed a multi-pronged approach including the gathering of intelligence and coordinated action across media, economic, and diplomatic channels.

The former premier did not specify the nature of the alleged damage attributed to Qatar or elaborate on the evidence underpinning his accusations against the Gulf state. Bennett's remarks represent a sharp escalation in rhetoric toward Qatar, though the details of his proposed campaign remained unclear.
